summary: Define bounded run authority and outcome traceability
description: Define and validate a serial project-run contract connecting original request, bounded goal, applicable vision/principles/accepted decisions, existing task R# outcomes and required delivery evidence. Freeze the minimum contract and governing architecture before dependent runtime work; do not build a second task queue. Scope and mandate: .go/plans/autonomy-first.json. Reuse released ABC/advice/readiness behavior; implement only this delta.
acceptance: Original intent and adopted goal are versioned and linked to task outcomes; accepted/proposed/delegated/unresolved decisions are distinguishable. Routine tuning uses existing authority; material out-of-mandate choices remain unresolved, never fabricated approvals.

The campaign contract bounds permitted tasks, research/repair expansion, model profiles, shared budget, release/deployment authority and stop conditions. An empty queue cannot authorize invented work from the broad vision.

Adopt a reasoned governing architecture brief/decision using existing principles and gates; no parallel builders, new human approval system or silent rewrite of historical contracts. Proposed fields must be validated with positive/negative and legacy fixtures.

Complete this independently shippable stack change with content-bound checks/critic, scoped commit/push, immutable release and remote readback; preserve user dirt and historical evidence. Current request authorizes planning only; no execution or publication starts during intake.
